summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe for HVDC, high-voltage grid equipment, transmission hardware, and power-quality components. The two-lane funnel keeps GE Vernova as the obvious HVDC/grid reference anchor, while the underfollowed lane surfaces Hubbell, Preformed Line Products, and American Superconductor as more component-level or power-quality exposures that may benefit from transmission buildout, renewable integration, data-center interconnection, and grid reliability spending. Evidence strength is highest for GE Vernova and Hubbell, moderate for PLPC, and more hypothesis-driven for AMSC because its relevance depends on whether utility and renewable interconnection demand increasingly converts into orders for D-VAR/reactive power and grid-resiliency systems. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around HVDC-adjacent and high-voltage grid components. The strongest underfollowed fit from provided evidence is Preformed Line Products, a transmission-line hardware supplier exposed to grid buildout rather than HVDC converter equipment directly. Additional candidates are included as hypotheses where the business plausibly touches grid power quality, switchgear, or utility electrical infrastructure, but requires primary-source verification before advancing. Expanded the US-listed universe for the HVDC/high-voltage components node with a two-lane funnel.
